snippet.title: Wingspan: Seasonal Decorative Pack - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wingspan: Seasonal Decorative Pack gives you unlimited access to the 7 seasonal backgrounds that have appeared in 2021, along with brand new matching avatars, only available with this pack! With this DLC you don’t have to wait for a specific season to use your favourite background; you are free as a bird and can choose any of them whenever you want!

Available NOW on Steam, GOG, Android, iOS, Nintendo Switch, and XBOX.
